name: LYSSINUM
key_symptoms: Lyssophobia; fear of becoming mad. Emotion and bad news aggravate; also, thinking of fluids. Hypersensitiveness of all senses. Chronic headache. Boring pain in forehead.
Voice altered in tone. Breathing held for a time. Spasmodic contraction of respiratory muscles.

worse: sight or sound of running water or pouring water, or even thinking of fluids

head_symptoms: Lyssophobia; fear of becoming mad. Emotion and bad news aggravate; also, thinking of fluids. Hypersensitiveness of all senses. Chronic headache. Boring pain in forehead.
respiratory_symptoms: Voice altered in tone. Breathing held for a time. Spasmodic contraction of respiratory muscles.
gi_symptoms: Desire for stool on hearing or seeing running water. Profuse, watery stools, with pain in bowels; worse, evening. Constant desire to urinate on seeing running water.
urinary_symptoms: Lascivious; priapism, with frequent emissions. No emission during coition. Atrophy of testicles. Complaints from abnormal sexual desire.
